race.comment: ROLLING MAGIC (12) building a good winning CV and has come back even stronger. Covered ground first up and cleared out for a sharp win over 1300m at this track in Midway grade. Drops 8kg in weight and ticks plenty of boxes in this stronger contest. Go close. ALTHOFF (11) snagged back early first-up, before returning slick closing splits from last on the turn with a slashing second over 1300m at this track. Will relish the fast tempo and looking for this trip now. SIR ARTIE (10) sent north for a well deserved victory over 1400m at Eagle Farm with the light weight. Confidence is high and look for him to swoop late. ATTICA (1) failed to come up last prep and returns a gelding. Serious horse on his day and the blinkers come off after the two searching trials. No surprise to see him sprint over the top of these. PIPPIE BEACH (8) saves her best for this track and trip and keep safe on the limit weight. Kept up to the mark with a 1030m tick over trial. The chances don't end there.
